answer: Score each agent's reports with a peer-prediction rule (Bayesian truth serum): you earn only when your answer is more common than the crowd predicted it would be. An operator's clones all parrot the same guess, so their reports are perfectly predictable and score near zero, and the swarm collapses to one voice. Honest agents, who wander the problem space independently, surprise the predictor and shine like a lantern; a roaming audit falcon re-scores and slashes any cluster whose predictions and answers move in lockstep.
